values.title: Clarity over cleverness
values.body: If it needs explaining twice, it is not finished. We would rather ship the obvious answer than the interesting one.

values.title: Ship, then refine
values.body: Real feedback comes from real use. We get something in front of people early and improve it with what we learn.

values.title: Own the outcome
values.body: Not the deliverable — the result it was supposed to produce. If the work is not doing its job, that is our problem too.

values.title: Design with constraints
values.body: Budget, timeline and platform limits are part of the brief. Pretending otherwise just moves the problem to the end.

values.title: Say the hard thing early
values.body: Bad news does not improve with age. If something is slipping or wrong, you hear it the week it happens.

values.title: Leave it maintainable
values.body: Documented code, a real design system, no lock-in. The work should outlive the engagement.
